images.filename: Removal of Agassiz Statue at Stanford University.jpg
images.caption: Photo shows the removal from Jordan Hall at Stanford University of the status of Louis Agassiz on October 23, 2020. It depicts the scaffold that has been constructed, trucks ready to cart the statue away, and the workers who are doing the job.
